data_architecture.objective: Expand clean, verified, deduplicated pretraining corpus and establish training readiness without pretraining weights or synthetic LLM answers.

sources.name: ChakrView Curated Multi-Domain Foundation
sources.origin: Local repository verified human/technical sources (data/raw and verified Corpus V4 clean segments)
sources.license: Internal Project Domain / Apache 2.0 / Public Domain
sources.domain: Multi-domain (English CS, Systems, Mathematics, Hindi, Hinglish, Algorithms, Classics)
sources.verification_method: SHA-256 hash deduplication, length filter, unicode normalization

sources.name: Wikipedia English Expository Articles
sources.origin: Wikimedia REST API / MediaWiki API (expository encyclopedic topics: Computer Science, Mathematics, Physical Sciences, History, Linguistics, World Geography, Engineering)
sources.verification_method: API text extract extraction, section header cleanup, min length 200 chars, strict deduplication

sources.name: Wikipedia Hindi Expository Articles
sources.origin: Wikimedia REST API (hi.wikipedia.org: Science, Geography, History, Literature, Technology, Mathematics in Devanagari)
sources.verification_method: API text extract extraction, Devanagari Unicode NFKC normalization, script purity check >= 70%

sources.verification_method: Syntax parseable via ast, comment and docstring preservation, deduplication
